item.title: ClovaLink — Enterprise File Storage without the price tag
item.description: Most storage platforms feel great until the bill shows up. Seats, bandwidth charges, and “enterprise tiers” eat your wallet. ClovaLink is an open-source, Rust-based, multi-tenant file system that runs self-hosted. It gives full data-residency control, works with S3-compatible storage, and has been shown to scale to ~10,000 users on a low-cost VPS with stable performance.
